definitions.explanation: A nose with a round, fleshy tip, likened to a dumpling ({団子|だんご}). Mildly unflattering, but often used affectionately or of oneself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{団子鼻|だんごばな}だ。
examples.english: My father has a bulbous nose.

examples.japanese: {団子鼻|だんごばな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦コンプレックス→コンプレックス：10863_konpurekkusu⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm self-conscious about my round nose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おじさん→おじさん：00803_ojisan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦キャラクター→キャラクター：23518_kyarakutaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{団子鼻|だんごばな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{丸|まる}い→丸い：02967_marui⟧⟦{眼鏡|めがね}→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{描|か}かれる→描く：28436_kaku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Middle-aged men in manga are often drawn with a bulbous nose and round glasses.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鷲鼻|わしばな}: hooked, aquiline nose
- ⟦{鼻|はな}が{高|たか}い→鼻が高い：10096_hanagatakai⟧: having a prominent nose (also: to be proud)
- ⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: having a flat, low nose

USAGE:
Talk about noses in Japanese focuses on height (⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ / ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧) and shape of the tip; {団子鼻|だんごばな} names a round, wide tip. Saying it of another person can sound rude, so it is mostly used of oneself, family or cartoon characters.
